[SWS_DM_00340] Waiting for Stop confirmation
⌈
After having called
Stop method of any Uds Transport Protocol implementation, it shall wait for the
corresponding HandlerStopped (see [SWS_DM_00314]) callback with the related
handler_id, before it finally terminates the process.
